items.text: Let it be. Chris chose his death at 361 and I'd already answered him; Gavin is nine seconds old and walked north into a room that holds a goblin *and* Chris's whole kit on the floor — a sword and armor at his feet on turn one is the best opening this world has given anyone, and it doesn't need a voice from the air to explain it. Watching whether the loot-and-fight resolves on its own; nothing to say yet.
